summary: Fix native diagnostic metadata parity and bounded proc reads

delivery.outcome: Repair reproduced provider metadata decoding/line-limit parity and prevent blocking or unbounded session process reads; publish through exact-head independent validation.
nonGoals: No user IDE signals, restarts or session database repairs
No protected CI/profile/policy changes or dependency additions

architecture.decision: Retain native acceleration for supported metadata, send unsupported JSON encodings/forms to Python, match first-line byte budget including newline, reject unsafe/nonregular metadata and bound all process reads in both paths.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of this bounded remediation; retain previous installed CLI release.

validation.evidence: Provider BOM/UTF16/unsupported JSON uses correct Python fallback; exact line budget parity.
Process metadata FIFO, symlink and oversize reads refuse promptly in worker and Python fallback.
Normal provider/process output and privacy remain unchanged; no compiler on cold queries.
Full mandatory X11 and governance/product checks plus protected publication.
